title: Bluetooth: refactor ctrl proc dissection
description:
When looking at Bluetooth LE logs, I want Wireshark to mark the LE control procedure packets with "Request in frame #" and "Response in frame #". Also, I want to be able to get a warning when control procedure sequencing is violated. Such violations may be:
 - One side starts a new control procedure before the previous has completed
 - An invalid response is sent to a control procedure packet.

This merge request is a preparation for this work. It removes the fall-throughs in the dissection of control procedure packets.
